thread:
Anita M (mktg-ops): Hey team — preflight for the April 15 product launch webinar. Quick checklist run? Need reg page, Zoom setup, recording routing, captions/transcript, and post-event follow-up timeline. Also want 3 short highlight clips.

Jess L (demand): I updated the HubSpot reg form — added timezone selector + GDPR consent + company size. Link: <https://hubspot.example/form/launch-apr15>. Set UTM params `utm_source=launch_email&utm_campaign=apr15_launch`.

Marco (events): Zoom config notes: cloud recording ON, record active speaker + gallery, enable audio transcript, save chat, and auto-assign co-host to @Tom P and @Anita M. Disable waiting room for smoother join, but enable "Alternative hosts" so speakers can start if I drop. Also I'll enable "Record to cloud" and tick "Save separate audio files".

Anita M (mktg-ops): @Marco can you also enable "Only authenticated users" = NO (we're gating via HubSpot). And please set a 10-min pre-meet for speakers.

Marco (events): Yup. Also setting up an RTMP fallback stream to backups.redwood-cdn.example in case Zoom cloud chokes. RTMP key in 1Password -> secure.

zoom-bot: Reminder: Webinar scheduled 2026-04-15 17:00 UTC (10:00 PDT). Cloud recording will be available ~1–2 hours after end.

Erin G (growth): Post-event plan: 1) Replay email to attendees within 6 hours. 2) Replay + content bundle to registrants (no-show) at 24h. 3) Nurture sequence for leads: MQL playbook for attendees (sales notif + calendar link), lead score + tags for feature interest. Who's writing the templates?

Jess L (demand): I'll draft two templates: Attendee replay (short clip + full recording) and No-show replay (on-demand + CTA). Tagging plan: `attended_apr15`, `watched_replay`, `lead_interest_{topic}`. I can wire these into HubSpot sequences tomorrow.

Tom P (product): For clips — want 3 x 60–90s: intro demo, key benchmark slide (latency/cost), customer quote. Can we auto-generate timestamps from the run?

Marco (events): Yes. We use the warp-split tool post-recording: command example: `warp-split --src s3://events/2026-04-15/apr15.mp4 --markers markers.json --clips 3 --out s3://events/2026-04-15/clips/` I'll attach marker conventions in the runbook.

Anita M (mktg-ops): Marker conventions: `00:02:30/demo-start`, `00:17:45/benchmark-slide`, `00:29:10/customer-quote`. If actual timings differ we'll adjust after dry run.

Marco (events): Dry run scheduled 2026-04-14 17:00 UTC. All speakers + cohosts please join 30m early for mics/checks.

Erin G (growth): Lead routing: attendees -> SDR queue A, registrants/no-show -> nurture (sequence id: NURT-APR15-1). Make sure HubSpot maps `company_size` to segment rules.

Jess L (demand): I'll export a CSV mapping for SDRs: `s3://marketing/exports/apr15_raw_leads.csv` and pusher job will run 2x: immediate post-event and 24h.

Tom P (product): Also want captions + transcript file (vtt + txt) for accessibility and for quoting. Marco, confirm transcript will be exported to S3 path above.

Marco (events): Affirmative: cloud transcript -> s3://events/2026-04-15/transcripts/apr15.vtt and `.txt`. Permissions: marketing_read + sales_read.

Anita M (mktg-ops): Checklist items left: speaker slide upload (Tom), CTA + landing page (Jess), 1Password RTMP key (Marco), replay email copy (Jess), clip markers (Tom), dry run attendance. Can we get a ✅ on each by EOD 2026-04-10?

Jess L (demand): ✅ I'll have hubspot + emails ready.

Marco (events): ✅ RTMP + Zoom settings + recording routing done.

Tom P (product): ✅ slides uploaded to `Drive/Launch/apr15/slides_v2.pdf`.

Erin G (growth): I'll prepare the SDR playbook + sample cadences, ETA 2026-04-11.

Anita M (mktg-ops): Perfect. One last note — post-event analytics: please include per-route token-level latency bench in the follow-up deck? (kidding :joy:) but seriously, include attendees by industry and session engagement metrics.

Marco (events): Noted. I'll enable engagement tracking for polls and Q&A and include a CSV.

zoom-bot: Cloud recording processed: apr15.mp4 ready -> s3://events/2026-04-15/apr15.mp4 (simulated post).

Anita M (mktg-ops): Thanks team — closing thread. If anything blocks, @channel ping me.
